text:
nina-partnerships: Kicking off VeloxAI Labs onboarding for their VXL-7 family. Goal: list in Azure Marketplace + optional SI appliance bundle (EU + UK first). Looping in legal, eng, ops, sales.

raj-legal: Need to review Velox91s license and a provenance attestation. If they expect downloadable weights on marketplace we require a non-redistribution addendum and geo restrictions. Also send them our short EAR export questionnaire.

carmen-eng: Hosting options: Redwood-hosted endpoint (no weights distributed), Azure Marketplace container (customer runs), or downloadable quantized artifact (S3 link + signed hash). For SI appliance we can supply an INT8 artifact + deployment container. Request: artifact checksum + quantization steps + tiny eval set.

leo-ops: Operational requirements: Marketplace container images must pass our EU image pipeline and carry signed provenance metadata. For download flows we need license gating + automated export flag. Who will draft the delivery flow?

tara-sales: Velox asked for a co-launch and demo webinar targeted at EU fintech partners. Sales wants a pilot discount for first 3 enterprise customers. Also need a short partner one-pager and speaker list.

lucy-legal: I will prepare a marketplace addendum template and pilot MSA tweak. Will ask Velox legal for a single POC.

nina-partnerships: Action list (short):
- Velox: send license + provenance attestation + export questionnaire (owner: Velox) 97 due Fri EOD
- Lucy: draft marketplace addendum + pilot MSA language (owner: lucy-legal) 97 due Mon noon
- Carmen: artifact requirements doc (hash, quant recipe, eval) + AMI/manifest stub (owner: carmen-eng) 97 due Mon 10am PT
- Leo: gated delivery + image pipeline checklist (owner: leo-ops) 97 due Tue 1pm PT
- Tara: one-pager + pilot pricing sketch (owner: tara-sales) 97 due Tue EOD

deploy-bot: Reminder set: "velox-marketplace-onboard-check" at 2736000160.

tara-sales: Ok to proceed with pilot ask. Will sync with Lucy on MSA changes.

carmen-eng: Also: request Velox include tokenizer + random seed for eval.

nina-partnerships: Great. I'll DM Velox legal and post the partner doc link here when they reply. Thanks all :rocket:
